_comment: The password the test team types on admin.html. meetrudi-tester-api compares it in constant
time and, on success, mints an ordinary session with role=admin - so the admin pane expires
on idle exactly like a tester's does.
No IAM change is needed: the runner role's ExternalApiSecrets statement already allows
Generate a real one and never reuse a password from anywhere else:
Until this secret exists, every /admin/* route answers 503 admin_not_configured - the pane
fails CLOSED, it does not fall open.
